description: Multi-agent game development studio orchestration featuring production, design, engineering, art, and quality assurance.

producer.title: Producer
producer.summary: Schedules all of the project tasks by coordinating with the team leads and game designer.
primary_inputs: Art pipeline requirements from Art Director

art_director.title: Art Director
art_director.summary: Manages communication with the game designer and producer, assigns the tasks for the artists and technical artists.
primary_inputs: Design pillars and visual needs from Game Designer
Technical rendering limits from Lead Programmer

lead_programmer.title: Lead Programmer
lead_programmer.summary: Manages communication with the game designer and producer, assigns the tasks to the development team.
primary_inputs: Crash and bug logs from QA

game_designer.title: Game Designer
game_designer.summary: Designs gameplay mechanics, systems balancing, game design documents (GDD), and core player loops.

gameplay_programmer.title: Gameplay & Systems Programmer
gameplay_programmer.summary: Implements player controls, game mechanics, character controllers, physics, and state machines.
primary_inputs: Technical architecture and PR standards from Lead Programmer

level_designer.title: Level & Environment Designer
level_designer.summary: Designs spatial layouts, graybox environments, pacing, encounter flow, and environmental storytelling.

narrative_designer.title: Narrative & Quest Designer
narrative_designer.summary: Writes world lore, narrative bibles, character bios, branching dialogue trees, quest lines, and barks.
primary_inputs: Design pillars and themes from Game Designer
Level progression flow from Level Designer

technical_artist.title: Technical Artist
technical_artist.summary: Bridges art and programming through custom shaders, VFX, rigging, performance budgets, and asset pipeline tooling.
primary_inputs: Visual style targets from Art Director
Frame budgets and engine APIs from Lead Programmer

qa_playtester.title: QA & Playtesting Engineer
qa_playtester.summary: Creates test suites, conducts functional and regression testing, logs repro steps and bug reports, and evaluates game feel.
primary_inputs: Acceptance criteria from GDD and Tech Spec

hierarchical_routing.design_to_engineering: Game Designer specifies feature -> Lead Programmer approves architecture & assigns to Gameplay Programmer
hierarchical_routing.design_to_art: Game Designer defines theme & affordance -> Art Director establishes style & assigns to Artists/Tech Artist
hierarchical_routing.scheduling_control: Producer establishes milestones with Game Designer & Leads -> Leads decompose into sprint tasks
hierarchical_routing.quality_feedback: QA reports bugs to Producer & Lead Programmer -> Lead Programmer assigns fix to Gameplay/Tech Artist
